<div class="parsedown-markdown"><h3 id="55135674_前情提要">前情提要</h3>
<p>本来看中评论区一位老哥的rime外观，急忙要来链接一看是fcitx5的，用不了。但实在太喜欢了，找半天没找着能代替的，干脆照着葫芦画瓢自己做了一个。<br>
折腾了快两天终于鼓捣出一个像样的外观，一共搬了两个配色。</p>
<h3 id="55135674_目录">目录</h3>
<ul>
<li>外观预览</li>
<li>配置代码</li>

<h3 id="55135674_外观预览">外观预览</h3>
<h3 id="55135674_weasel.custom.yaml配置（黑色配色）">weasel.custom.yaml配置（黑色配色）</h3>
<p><strong> 注释由AI添加，请以官方文档为准 </strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml"># ================================
# Rime / 小狼毫 (Weasel) 用户配置
# ================================
customization:&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 根键：自定义配置块
&nbsp;&nbsp;config_version: 0.25&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 配置文件的版本号，用于兼容性检查
&nbsp;&nbsp;distribution_code_name: Weasel&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 发行版代码名称，此处为小狼毫（Windows 前端）
&nbsp;&nbsp;distribution_version: 0.17.4&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 小狼毫的版本号
&nbsp;&nbsp;generator: "Weasel::UIStyleSettings"&nbsp;&nbsp;# 生成此配置文件的程序模块
&nbsp;&nbsp;modified_time: "Tue Apr 14 13:39:23 2026"&nbsp;&nbsp;# 文件最后修改时间
&nbsp;&nbsp;rime_version: 1.13.1&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 所依赖的 Rime 核心引擎版本
patch:&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 补丁块：用于覆盖或扩展现有默认配置
&nbsp;&nbsp;__include: "hot_keys:/patch"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 从外部文件 "hot_keys" 中引入 /patch 节点下的内容
&nbsp;&nbsp;# 应用程序行为设置
&nbsp;&nbsp;app_options:
&nbsp; &nbsp; cmd.exe: {ascii_mode: true}&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 在命令提示符中默认使用英文模式
&nbsp; &nbsp; conhost.exe: {ascii_mode: true}&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 在控制台主机中默认使用英文模式
&nbsp;&nbsp;global_ascii: false&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 全局默认输入状态是否为英文（false=中文）
&nbsp;&nbsp;# 配色方案（皮肤）
&nbsp;&nbsp;preset_color_schemes:
&nbsp; &nbsp; WeChat-Dark:&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 定义一个颜色方案
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;author: "man"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 方案作者
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;name: WeChat-Dark&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 方案内部名称
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 窗口基础颜色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;back_color: 0xFF151515&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 窗口背景色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;border_color: 0xFF515253&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 窗口边框颜色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;shadow_color: 0x88000000&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 窗口阴影颜色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 普通文字颜色（非高亮）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;text_color: 0xFFd69c56&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 预编辑区普通文字颜色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;candidate_text_color: 0xFFb7b7b7&nbsp;&nbsp;# 候选项文字颜色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;label_color: 0xFFb7b7b7&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 候选项序号颜色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;comment_text_color: 0xFFb7b7b7&nbsp; &nbsp; # 注释文字颜色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 高亮区域颜色（预编辑区）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;hilited_back_color: 0xFF151515&nbsp; &nbsp;# 预编辑区高亮背景色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;hilited_text_color: 0xFFd69c56&nbsp; &nbsp; # 预编辑区高亮文字颜色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 高亮区域颜色（候选区）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;hilited_candidate_back_color: 0xFF70a831&nbsp; &nbsp;# 候选词高亮背景色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;hilited_candidate_text_color: 0xFFf0fbf4&nbsp; &nbsp;# 候选词高亮文字颜色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;hilited_label_color: 0xFFf0fbf4&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 候选词高亮序号颜色
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;hilited_comment_text_color: 0xFFf0fbf4&nbsp; &nbsp;# 候选词高亮注释颜色
&nbsp;&nbsp;# 通知设置
&nbsp;&nbsp;show_notifications: true&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 是否显示状态通知
&nbsp;&nbsp;show_notifications_time: 800&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 通知显示时长（毫秒）
&nbsp;&nbsp;# 样式设置块
&nbsp;&nbsp;style:
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 字体设置
&nbsp; &nbsp; font_face: "霞鹜文楷等宽"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 主文字字体
&nbsp; &nbsp; font_point: 14&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 主文字字号
&nbsp; &nbsp; label_font_face: "霞鹜文楷等宽"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 序号字体
&nbsp; &nbsp; label_font_point: 14&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 序号字号
&nbsp; &nbsp; comment_font_face: "霞鹜文楷等宽"&nbsp; &nbsp; # 注释字体
&nbsp; &nbsp; comment_font_point: 14&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 注释字号
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 文字格式
&nbsp; &nbsp; label_format: "%s"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 序号显示格式（%s 表示数字）
&nbsp; &nbsp; comment_format: "%s"&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 注释显示格式（%s 表示原始内容）
&nbsp; &nbsp; mark_text: " "&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 标记当前选中候选项的文本（空格=无标记）
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 候选窗口行为
&nbsp; &nbsp; horizontal: true&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 候选项是否水平排列（false=垂直）
&nbsp; &nbsp; inline_preedit: true&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 是否内嵌显示预编辑区
&nbsp; &nbsp; preedit_type: composition&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 预编辑区显示方式（composition=完整编码串）
&nbsp; &nbsp; paging_on_scroll: false&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 是否允许鼠标滚轮翻页
&nbsp; &nbsp; click_to_capture: false&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 是否通过点击候选窗捕获焦点
&nbsp; &nbsp; enhanced_position: false&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 是否启用增强的候选窗定位
&nbsp; &nbsp; antialias_mode: default&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 抗锯齿模式
&nbsp; &nbsp; ascii_tip_follow_cursor: false&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 英文模式提示是否跟随光标
&nbsp; &nbsp; candidate_abbreviate_length: 0&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 候选项缩写长度（0=不缩写）
&nbsp; &nbsp; hover_type: none&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 鼠标悬停效果类型
&nbsp; &nbsp; fullscreen: false&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 候选窗是否占满全屏
&nbsp; &nbsp; text_orientation: horizontal&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 候选窗整体文字方向
&nbsp; &nbsp; vertical_auto_reverse: false&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 垂直模式下是否自动反转顺序
&nbsp; &nbsp; vertical_text: false&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 是否强制垂直文字排版
&nbsp; &nbsp; vertical_text_left_to_right: false&nbsp;&nbsp;# 垂直文字是否从左向右排列
&nbsp; &nbsp; vertical_text_with_wrap: false&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 垂直文字是否允许换行
&nbsp; &nbsp; display_tray_icon: false&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 是否显示系统托盘图标
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 配色方案引用
&nbsp; &nbsp; color_scheme: WeChat-Dark&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 当前使用的配色方案
&nbsp; &nbsp; color_scheme_dark: WeChat-Dark&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 暗色模式下的配色方案
&nbsp; &nbsp; # 候选窗布局参数
&nbsp; &nbsp; layout:
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 窗口外边距
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;margin_x: 12&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 窗口内容左右外边距（像素）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;margin_y: 12&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 窗口内容上下外边距（像素）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;spacing: 20&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 预编辑区与候选区之间的垂直距离
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;border_width: 2&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 边框线宽（像素）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;corner_radius: 10&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 窗口外围圆角半径（像素）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;round_corner: 10&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 窗口外围圆角半径（与 corner_radius 相同）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 候选词间距
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;candidate_spacing: 15&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 候选项之间的水平间距（像素）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;hilite_spacing: 8&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 高亮候选项与相邻项的间距（像素）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 高亮区域内边距
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;hilite_padding_x: 9&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 高亮候选项水平内边距（像素）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;hilite_padding_y: 9&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 高亮候选项垂直内边距（像素）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 阴影
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;shadow_offset_x: 4&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 阴影水平偏移（像素，正值向右）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;shadow_offset_y: 4&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 阴影垂直偏移（像素，正值向下）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;shadow_radius: 2&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 阴影模糊半径（像素）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 文字对齐
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;align_type: center&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 候选框内文字垂直对齐方式（center=居中）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;baseline: 100&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 文字基线位置（百分比，增大数值文字下移）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 窗口尺寸限制
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;min_width: 0&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 候选窗最小宽度（0=不限制）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;min_height: 0&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 候选窗最小高度（0=不限制）
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;max_width: 2800&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; # 候选窗最大宽度
&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;max_height: 2800&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;# 候选窗最大高度
&nbsp;&nbsp;# 指定配色方案
&nbsp;&nbsp;"style/color_scheme": WeChat-Dark</code></pre>
